name: 19333 · Devon, PA
findings: ZIP 19333 (Devon) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19333 (Devon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19333 (Devon) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

observations.text: 7 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
